details: Negotiations between the United States and Iran over a peace deal and the reopening of the crucial Strait of Hormuz have reached an impasse. US President Donald Trump has demanded compensation from Iran for damages, complicating efforts to de-escalate tensions. This geopolitical standoff has led to a rise in oil prices, with Brent crude futures climbing towards $90 a barrel, and contributes to broader global inflation concerns. The Strait of Hormuz is a vital chokepoint for global oil transportation, making any disruption or uncertainty in the region a significant factor for energy markets.
title: US-Iran Strait of Hormuz Standoff Pushes Oil Prices Up

details: The crypto market is closely watching the release of the US July Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, due on August 12. This inflation report is a key macroeconomic event that will heavily influence Federal Reserve interest rate policy expectations. Ahead of the CPI release, Bitcoin and Ethereum Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) saw significant combined inflows of approximately $1.1 billion for the week ending August 7, primarily driven by institutional demand. A hotter-than-expected CPI could reignite fears of further Fed rate hikes, potentially pressuring crypto prices, while a cooler reading might extend the current institutional interest in risk assets.
title: Crypto Markets Await US CPI Data Amid Institutional Inflows
